reports.title: GOOSEHEAD INSURANCE, INC. RELEASES PRELIMINARY THIRD QUARTER 2026 RESULTS

guidance.heading: Full Year 2026 Outlook
section: We are reaffirming guidance for the full year 2026 as follows:
•Total revenues are expected to grow organically between 12% and 19% considering the expected range of impact of the restatement as noted below
•Total written premiums are expected to grow between 12% and 20%.

desk.headline: Preliminary revenue up about 17% to $108.8–110.8m, above estimate; full results delayed by a restatement; FY26 outlook reaffirmed
results: Only preliminary, unreviewed figures were released: total revenue of $108.8–110.8m, up about 17% at the midpoint. No profit or EPS figures were given.
Core Revenue (renewals, new business and fees) rose 13% to $94.7m; renewal royalty fees grew to $53.4m from $45.7m.
Written premiums rose 11% to $1.31bn and policies in force rose 14% to about 2.1m; client retention was 86% but premium retention slipped to 87% from 93%.

After an SEC comment letter, the company said its 2023–2025 accounts and early-2026 quarterly reports can no longer be relied on and will be restated (sales commissions should have been capitalised; certain franchise fees should be booked as revenue).
Cash was $32.8m at 30 Sep, with $322.3m of notes outstanding and $26.0m drawn on a $75.0m credit line; $144.6m remains under the buyback authorisation.

guidance.summary: Full-year 2026 guidance was reaffirmed: total revenue growth of 12–19% (the width reflects the expected restatement impact) and written premium growth of 12–20%.

watch: Timing of the restated 10-K/A and 10-Qs and the final Q3 figures, including profit.
The size of the restatement: the company expects 2025 revenue and G&A to each rise by about $11–16m, with no change to profit or cash from that part.
Whether premium retention keeps falling from 87%.
